description: Golden fixtures for services/inventory_normalize.py (design doc 04, test T2). Every row of the doc 02 section 4 tables plus values recorded on the reference appliance. 'expect' lists only the fields a case asserts; null means the field must be None. A device case with 'agrees_without_sys_descr' must give the same OS identity with and without its sys_descr. 'engine_probe' holds inputs only (no expectations): test_inventory_normalize.py digests what the engine returns for them together with the cases above, and pins that digest per RULEPACK_REV, so an engine change cannot slip through without a revision bump. Names starting n01..n17 are regression cases for the findings of the Phase 0 review.
